title: Roster Entry
description: A roster entry used in the admin UI.

person_uuid.description: Stable UUID for the local person write model behind this derived roster projection.

cluster_count.description: Number of clusters assigned to this entry.

source_version.description: Latest mirrored cluster snapshot version used to build this derived roster projection.

projection_status.description: Freshness state of the local derived roster projection.

projection_refreshed_at.description: Last local projection refresh timestamp, or null when the projection has never been refreshed.
